summary: Verified ITER129 admin login 502-on-email-send-failure change in /app/backend/routers/admin/admin_auth.py. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass on preview + prod probes. Frontend: /admin/login flow advances to OTP step with masked email con***@centraders.com and 'OTP sent to your email!' toast. 502 error-handling change did not break the happy path end-to-end (initiate -> OTP from Mongo -> verify-otp returns session_token + is_admin=true). Production probes confirm Resend is genuinely sending (prod /api/admin/login/initiate 200 and /api/auth/send-otp returns the genuine 'OTP sent to your email' message, not the fallback/dev wording).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_auth.py line 97: email_masked uses email[:3] which exposes 3 chars of the local part. Fine for the admin flow (user owns the inbox), but if this helper is reused for arbitrary users consider masking all but 1-2 chars.
On 502 the token is correctly deleted from Mongo (line 89) so stale token_ids are not left behind — good.
seed_data_creation: None. One real OTP was consumed on PREVIEW by test_full_2fa_flow (sent via Resend to contact.us@centraders.com, then immediately verified so no stale token remains).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://aarohmm-partner--18pkutrq.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds and OTP-retrieval-from-Mongo recipe in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Regression test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter129_admin_login_502.py — note test_prod_initiate_sanity + test_full_2fa_flow consume a real Resend send each.
rca of the issue: User-facing 'no OTP arriving' is NOT a code bug — Render-hosted prod backend demonstrably sends via Resend (verified by test_prod_send_otp_genuine which gets the genuine success wording that only returns when Resend accepts the send). centraders.com MX is ProtonMail with DMARC p=quarantine; likely the OTP mails land in Proton spam/quarantine. Mitigation for the user: whitelist noreply@centraders.com in ProtonMail, or inspect quarantine. The code-level 502 change makes future send-failures visible instead of silently returning success, and preview tests confirm the happy path still works.
